flux1Diagnostic.selection: Use score-blind frozen R1 public sample membership; no SAFE-score selection.

hypotheses: SAFE retains useful high-authority synthetic evidence on independent modern generator families at its already frozen operating point.
SAFE applicability decreases measurably under common recompression, resampling, screenshot and blur regimes without turning input quality into authenticity evidence.
The public-to-Cloudflare FLUX.1 score gap is partly explained by measurable encoding or input-regime factors, or remains a documented domain-risk if it is not.
SPAI, RINE and UFD provide descriptive error-diversity evidence but cannot change SAFE qualification or thresholds.

qualificationConfirm.selection: Enumerate paths at pinned historical revision; sort SHA256(WP007H + family + relativePath); take first 20; no pixel or SAFE-score selection.

qualificationDev.reason: SAFE operating point is frozen; WP007H is independent qualification, not threshold design.

confirmation.target: all eligible unused source families after exclusion of every prior WP006-WP007 role and final sealed family

reserve.target: only if unused source families remain after confirmation allocation; unopened until confirmation is complete

negativeRoles.rights: CSAFE CC BY 4.0 attribution-bound internal research; controlled digital only where manifest grants research eligibility; no final sealed controls

objective: Qualify frozen SAFE as a primary EF3 specialist within measurable input regimes and investigate the public-to-Cloudflare FLUX.1 domain shift without fitting a new ensemble.

planHashing.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON, sorted keys, compact separators, with planSha256 omitted

qualificationGates.fprTargetDemonstrationRule: Do not claim a <=1% population bound unless sample size and interval support it; otherwise report FPR_TARGET_NOT_YET_DEMONSTRATED.

safeFrozenConfiguration.preprocessing: RGB decode; torchvision CenterCrop(256,256); ToTensor; official SAFE DWT/model path; class-1 softmax
safeFrozenConfiguration.thresholdSource: WP007G-R1 NEGATIVE_CALIBRATION_G only; frozen before WP007H curation

shadowSupporters.purpose: Descriptive error-diversity and future router evidence only.

transformations.purpose: Measure SAFE applicability and evidence movement; transformation quality is not authenticity evidence.
